name: brewery_padulles2026
description: Generalized reference brewery: 12 process streams, loads per hectolitre of beer.
reference: Padullés et al. (2026), Energy Conversion and Management 357, 121292, Table 2.

cycle_screening._note: Candidates from Andersen et al. (2024), Table 2, available in CoolProp. R1234ze(Z) omitted: outside CoolProp's range at the -7 °C evaporation needed. Cascades and two-stage cycles only for the HTHP (lift 104 K).

limits._source: IEA HPT Annex 58 Task 1 report (2023): Table 1-3 (single-stage pressure ratio up to 10 for piston/scroll; conservative, screw allows > 20) and Sec. 1.2.1 (ammonia compressors about 76 bar, 110 °C)

provenance.eta_lorenz: EDUCATED APPROXIMATION (author decision, 2026-10-17): 0.50, not a published or measured value. It lies inside the range implied by the Danish Energy Agency HTHP sheets (0.45-0.52) and between our cycle model's warm-water heat pump (0.48-0.49) and high-temperature cascade (0.54-0.56). Padullés et al. (2026, Sec. 4.3.1) use 0.55 (kept for the paper reproduction and as a sensitivity row)
provenance.source_T_C: published cold-utility temperature (Sec. 4.1); used for all sources, which bounds W from above
provenance.sink levels: published warm-water tank 18-82 °C (Fig. 14); HTHP at GCC maximum T* (assumed, consistent with COP 2)
provenance.basis: assumed: 1.0 million hl/year, within the published range of Table 1 (0.25-1.5 million hl/year); economics at 8000 h/year (published)
provenance.area_targeting: film coefficients: Stampfli et al. (2018) Table 1, mapping assumed; cost laws: Sinnott and Towler (2020) Table 6.6 plate and frame (primary) and Stampfli et al. (2018) Table 2, bare and x3.5 (Hand factor, Towler Table 6.3); cold utility cost from chiller COP
provenance.cycle_screening: step 4b: cycle model with Andersen et al. (2024) Table 3 assumptions; validated against their Appendix A (see tests/test_cycle.py)
provenance.retrofit: step 5, option (a): existing network = Padullés et al. (2026) Sec. 4.2 (Pfaduko + wort-cooling HR tank), data/brewery_networks.json
provenance.warm-water heat pump name: 'Warm-water HP' = the CO2 heat pump of Padullés et al. (2026, config. 2); our cycle screening selects propane with SLHX as the practical fluid (step 4b), so the unit is named by its duty

sources.prices: Eurostat nrg_pc_205 (electricity, band ID 2,000-19,999 MWh) and nrg_pc_203 (gas, band I3 10,000-99,999 GJ), Portugal, 2026-S1, excluding VAT and other recoverable taxes and levies, EUR/kWh (gas on GCV). Parsed copy: data/sources/eurostat_portugal_prices.csv. Band check: gas fuel ~ 1.2e7 kWh/year = 43,000 GJ (I3); heat pump electricity alone 3.4 GWh/year (ID); site electricity 7.5-11.5 kWh/hl for breweries above 1 Mhl/y (IFC EHS Guidelines for Breweries 2007, Table 3) + heat pumps 3.4-3.9 kWh/hl = 11-15 GWh/year: band ID. ID is also the conservative choice (dearer than IE)
sources.boiler_efficiency: DEA Technology Data - Industrial Process Heat, sheet 6.1 (2025): 93.9 % net (NCV) annual average, steam boiler with economiser; x 0.90 (NCV/GCV) = 0.845 on the GCV basis of the gas price. Gas prices are on GCV: Regulation (EU) 2016/1952, Annex I, point 4; NCV/GCV = 0.90: IPCC (1996) Reference Manual, Ch. 1, Table 1-4 note a (10 % for natural gas)
sources.grid_EF_kg_per_kWh: APA, Fator de Emissao da Eletricidade - 2025, Table T1: Portugal 2023 = 0.107 t CO2eq/MWh (production-based)
sources.heat_recovery_equipment: tank 520.8 m3 = 375 m3 x (1.0e6 / 720,000 hl/year), scaled from Padullés et al. (2026), Sec. 5.1
sources.gas_EF_kg_per_kWh: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol. 2 Table 2.2, 56,100 kg CO2/TJ NCV -> 0.182 kg/kWh GCV, direct combustion (same scope as the APA grid factor)
sources.eta_lorenz_sensitivity: 0.45-0.52: Carnot efficiencies implied by DEA HTHP sheets (COP 2.05 at 100 K lift); 0.63: Andersen et al. (2024) polynomial for the HTHP unit (upper envelope, extrapolated: source below 0 °C and isothermal)
sources.co2_price_scenario: EUA Dec contract 82.40 EUR/t on 5 Oct 2026 (S&P Global Commodity Insights)
sources.chiller_cop: Sinnott and Towler (2020), Chemical Engineering Design, 6th ed. (Elsevier, ISBN 978-0-08-102599-4), Sec. 6.4.4, Eq. 6.20: real COP about 0.6 x Carnot for a simple cycle. Evaporator at cold utility -1 °C minus 5 K (refrigerated-brine approach 3-5 K, Sec. 12.7.3), condenser at ambient 15 °C + 10 K cooling-water rise + 5 K approach = 30 °C: 0.6 x 267.15/36 = 4.45. Check: CoolProp ammonia cycle (Andersen et al. 2024 assumptions, sink 15->25 °C) gives 4.52. Padullés et al. (2026) give no chiller credit

plate_hex.source: Sinnott and Towler (2020), Table 6.6, plate and frame (304 SS), Ce = 1,350 + 180 S^0.95 USD Jan 2007; x 3.5 Hand installation factor (Table 6.3); x CEPCI 797.9/509.7; / 1.0816 USD/EUR (ECB, 2023 mean of monthly averages); CEPCI 2017 = 567.5 and 2023 = 797.9 confirmed in Chem. Eng. Sept. 2024, p. 45 (latest monthly: May 2024 final 800.2). Valid 1-500 m2

area_targeting.film_coefficients_source: Stampfli et al. (2018), CET 70, 901-906, Table 1 (dairy streams): product 500, water 2,000, evaporation/condensation 5,000 W/(m2 K); checked against the PDF. Mapping to brewery streams is our assumption: water for brewing-water, CIP and condensate; product for mash, wort and beer; latent for boiling and boil-off condensation.

cost_law.label: Towler 2020 plate & frame, bare (F = 1)
cost_law.source: Sinnott and Towler (2020), Table 6.6: plate and frame exchanger, 304 SS, Ce = 1,350 + 180 S^0.95 USD (USGC, Jan 2007, CEPCI 509.7), valid 1-500 m2; x CEPCI 797.9/509.7 (2023) / 1.0816 USD/EUR (ECB Data Portal EXR.M.USD.EUR.SP00.A, mean of the 2023 monthly averages). No location factor (Portugal not in Table 6.7)

cost_law.label: Towler 2020 x 3.5 (Hand factor, installed)
cost_law.source: As above x 3.5: Hand (1958) installation factor for heat exchangers, Sinnott and Towler (2020) Table 6.3 (includes home-office costs, not offsites or contingency)

cost_law.label: Stampfli 2018 (cross-check only), bare (F = 1)
cost_law.source: Stampfli et al. (2018), Table 2: stainless-steel plate HEX, MPIC = 4,350 + 660 A NZD (assumed 2017 NZD, from Bouman et al. 2005 indexed with Stats NZ 2017); / 1.5897 NZD/EUR (ECB Data Portal EXR.A.NZD.EUR.SP00.A, 2017) x CEPCI 797.9/567.5 (2023/2017). Bare equipment cost: lower bound

cost_law.label: Stampfli 2018 (cross-check only) x 3.5 (Hand factor)
cost_law.source: As above x 3.5, Hand (1958) installation factor for heat exchangers, verified in Sinnott and Towler (2020) Table 6.3. Note: Stampfli's coefficients do not match Bouman et al. (2005) gasketed plate HEX (MPIC = 270 A + 2,540 NZD, Dec 2004, 0.7-3 MW), so their base is unverified

new_exchanger._medium_h: tank water: Stampfli et al. (2018) water category

options.name: N1 + both heat pumps, cycle-based COP

retrofit._heat_pump_reference: RQ1 and RQ3 per unit judge the heat pumps as increments over the heat-recovery-only retrofit, so the cheap recovery measure does not carry them (supervisor review, item A1)
